items.name: Anaheim Qualifier 2019
items.information: * This is a qualifying competition for CubingUSA National Championship 2019 and WCA World Championship 2019. You may still attend this competition even if you will not be attending any of the above mentioned competitions. * There is no 3x3 at this competition. * The registration fee of $20.00 will be paid in cash on the day of the competition. Please do not register if you will not be attending. * Please do not register for blindfolded events if you cannot solve cubes blindfolded. * If you choose to compete in Clock, please make sure you have a Clock that is competition legal. Regulations regarding Clock can be found [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/guidelines.html#article-3-puzzles).

items.information: Please read the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ColoradoQualifiers2019#10271-competitor-responsibilities) tab before registering for the competition. This tab has very important information regarding a competitor's roles during the competition. Please note that this event can only accommodate 150 competitors. We also ask that guests be kept to a minimum to ensure enough room for the competitors. Be sure to register early to guarantee a spot!

items.name: Koalafication Palmy 2019
items.information: Koalafication Palmy 2019 is open to competitors of all ages and ability. If you can solve the puzzle in under 10 minutes then you can enter. Entry for spectators is free for whats sure to be a fun filled day. This competition will feauture events that are held less frequently with the main purpose being to act as a qualifier for this years WCA World Championship being held in Melbourne Australia. For more information, visit the [WCA World Championship 2019 website](https://wc2019.speedcubing.org.au/en/).

items.name: Koalafication Perth 2019
items.information: This competition is part of a series of events around Australia to enable competitors to obtain qualifying results for the upcoming WCA World Championship 2019 in Melbourne. items.information: This competition has only blindfolded and fewest move events. Spectators and competitors must remain silent whenever anyone is competing, to allow for concentration. Note that the only thing before lunch on Saturday is a Multi-Blind attempt. If you are not competiting in this event, or only want to do the later two attempts, you do not need to arrive until after lunch on Saturday. In the event that we do not have enough (at least 16) competitors to allow for the third round of 3x3x3 Blindfolded, we will start Sunday 30 minutes later than scheduled.

items.name: SacCubing VII 2019
items.information: ![Image description](https://b2b989d215c701ad63d7-288404e13f895703cf2798bf6ae95228.ssl.cf1.rackcdn.com/734655566969-350.png) Sacramento's seventh competition is here! Make sure to sign up to reserve your spot! Registration fee is $20, and you are permitted to sign up for all available events. **Note: The venue for SacCubing VII 2019 is in a different location compared to previous SacCubing competitions.** All competitors must be available to judge/run/scramble for the competition as per Regulation [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2). All competitors will be expected to help by judging or running for any event they are doing. Nametags will be handed out with all the information regarding what groups you will be competing in and what groups you will be helping in. If you are not competing in an event, you will not be assigned to help during that event. All donations are appreciated and will go towards things such as venue, supplies, etc.
